availability.p: The text is released under CC0 1.0: under French law, the text of a critical edition is not protected by copyright (CA Paris, Pôle 5, 2ème Ch., 9 June 2017, no. 16/00005).

This XML text (filename tlg0545005.xml) was originally generated by Diogenes (version 4.6.2) from the TLG corpus of classical texts (author number 0545, work number 005), which was once distributed on CD-ROM in a very different file format.
The citation structure and the metadata are released under CC-BY 4.0.

This file has then been released by the Corpus Liberatum Linguae Graecae (dir. Thibault Clérice) which added citeStructure information, bibliographical metadata and reworked, where applicable, the citation structure to follow edition and physical citation systems.
